correctness.rationale: Constants verified independently: re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_target.py and verify_qtilde.py -> VERIFY_OK. Exact rationals correct: I0=4pi/15, Gamma0=4pi/3, E0,H=8pi/315, relative moment M0=16pi/23625, decaying-psi moment Qtilde_H=16pi/945 (interior 8pi/1575 + exterior 8pi/675), kappa0^2=E0/Qtilde=3/2, sharp positivity threshold 3. Quadrature relerr <4e-3, Stokes FD defect ~5e-4, W=2/15 match exact. These are correctly computed moments of the known explicit Hill stream function. Essential PDE inferences FAIL: (1) Lemma 5.2 W_kappa=0 exclusion is incomplete. Case (i) graft adds mass with Delta I>0, hence is not an admissible circulation-only variation preserving the impulse equality I=I0; inferring contradiction with Kuhn-Tucker at W=0 requires proving the value function s_kappa(I) has strictly positive derivative at I0, which is asserted via (5.3)-(5.5) with undefined uniform interior constants c0, r_*, osc(phi) and strict Phi-gap across the free boundary (unproved). Case (ii) swap argument similarly asserts existence of outward pair with Phi-gap without construction. (2) Uniform lower bound inf_[0,barkappa] W>=bar w>0 via contradiction is invalid as written: it invokes kappa_j^2/2 D Qtilde ->0 in L^infty_loc to force limit EL to Hill EL with W*=W_H=2/15, which holds only if kappa_j->0, not for a sequence with kappa_j->kappa_*>0 in (0,barkappa]; pointwise positivity on (0,kappa0) therefore not established, and uniform support radius (5.6) depending on bar w is not established. (3) Convergence claims assume W_kappa->W_H and gamma_kappa->0 and uniform Phi_kappa convergence on compacts by the same cluster argument, but multiplier convergence/compactness is not proved and is circular with (2); Hausdorff support convergence therefore not proved. (4) Headline/target mismatch: admitted target requires L psi = r^2 H'(psi)+(1/2r^2)(C_kappa^2)'(psi) local Bragg-Hawthorne/GS steady Euler equation. DRAFT Sec.4 expressly disclaims the pointwise local semilinear identity at fixed kappa>0 beyond the distributional patch identity S psi_kappa=r^2 xi_kappa (which holds by definition psi=K xi) with indicator of the nonlocal swirl-shifted Phi_kappa containing K(psi_+/r^2). The nonlocal term is not a local function of psi, so no exact fixed-kappa Euler steady state in the admitted local sense is proved. Proof vs citation distinguished: FT kernel/decay/tightness/bathtub/Amick-Fraenkel uniqueness cited as black boxes (acceptable in principle) but the new penalty-specific multiplier analysis that must close the argument has the above gaps.

originality.rationale: claim_route=TARGET per research_report; audited normally against admitted fixed-impulse small-swirl Hill target. Live retrieval performed for (a) literal, (b) equivalent/dual, (c) dominance forms via exa_web_search_advanced_exa (numResults<=10, no category restriction) plus scope-literature-search openalex/crossref cross-checks and full fetch of decisive sources. Nearest priors compared literally: Choi 2011.06808 is kappa=0 swirl-free Hill maximizer/stability only, no swirl profile, no kappa0/kappa1; Cao-Wan-Zhan 1909.00355 and Cao-Zhan 2009.13210 are thin-core epsilon->0 filament desingularizations with different constraints, no fixed Hill-impulse window; Turkington 1989 Vortex Rings with Swirl (SIAM JMA, helicity-invariant variational principle, bounded-domain/translating rings, large-swirl filament desingularization) is the broadest swirl-existence framework but prescribes different invariants, does not fix impulse to Hill-ball I0, does not define quadratic penalty Qtilde=b^2 int (Kxi)_+^2/r^2 over R^3, does not state kappa0=sqrt(3/2)/b, Qtilde_H=16pi/945, or kappa->0 Hill-ball Hausdorff limit. Failure modes tested: synonymous Bragg-Hawthorne/Long-Squire/Grad-Shafranov notation, helicity vs penalty encodings, subset/special-case dominance by Turkington/Cao general f,g frameworks, exact table/database appearance of I0/E0/Qtilde_H/kappa0, and recomputation/corollary status. No source states or substantively implies the exact penalized-window headline; Qtilde_H evaluation is elementary calculus from known Hill psi, but the combined penalized-window statement is absent. Originality PASSES (novel as penalized-surrogate statement), which does not rescue value.

value.rationale: TARGET route carries no preset-fallback value presumption (fallback Pohozaev cutoff explicitly abandoned in DRAFT Sec.7 as unprovable; research_report confirms fallback NOT claimed). Judged on admitted TARGET headline alone under ordinary value standard. FAIL as intrinsic low value / arbitrary scope / missing substantive Euler result: (1) Objects proved at fixed kappa>0 are nonlocal penalized FT patches, not exact local Bragg-Hawthorne Euler states (disclaimed in Sec.4/6 and limitations), so downstream stability/filament/leapfrogging uses cited in value_case, which require exact steady Euler solutions, do not follow. (2) Explicit kappa0=sqrt(3/2)/b is not an intrinsic bifurcation: b>0 is author-chosen penalty shape (kappa0 scales 1/b), and sqrt(3/2) is author-chosen half-energy margin E0,H/2; DRAFT Sec.6 admits sharp positivity of the same Hill-competitor bound is 3, so the stated number is a conservative convention, not physics-forced. The alternative relative-psi moment gives kappa0^2=75/2, confirming definition-dependence (interior vs decaying-plus-exterior-dipole integral). (3) Apart from routine verification that Qtilde is finite/C1/weakly continuous, the argument is a small continuous perturbation re-running FT compactness plus uniqueness to get kappa->0 limit; no sharp threshold, no completed census, no new exact swirling Hill family, no obstruction (fallback gone). This is a tiny unmotivated gain / parameter-substitution envelope around known FT/Choi Hill theory with an unexplained-number flavor despite honest numerics. A bounded addition (motivation paragraph, database citation) cannot convert a nonlocal surrogate with conventional cutoff into an exact Euler existence window; requires new research direction. Hence REJECT, not repairable.
